forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: No credible AGI declaration since last update. Anthropic launched Claude Mythos 5 (10T params); Google's Cloud Next 2026 highlighted agentic AI tools (no AGI claim). Anthropic secured $25B Amazon + $40B Google commitments — validating commercial momentum but not capability. Metaculus combined forecast still pegs AGI mid-2030 (80% CI 2027-2043). 'ASI Finals' headlines (Meta and xAI reportedly faltering) suggest race acceleration but no near-term resolution trigger. ~32 months remaining; hold at 25%.
forecasts.base_rate: ~25% aggregated from Metaculus, Kalshi, Polymarket, and expert surveys for AGI by end-2029
factors_up: Metaculus median AGI arrival still ~mid-2030 (+3pp)
Anthropic $25B+$40B funding commitments validate commercial AGI race (+3pp)
Claude Mythos 5 (10T params) and Google's Project Mariner advance agentic frontier (+2pp)
ASI Finals narrative — only 3 viable frontier labs remain, accelerating focus (+2pp)
factors_down: No credible lab declaration of AGI in past 30 days (-4pp)
Resolution window now <33 months (-3pp)
Definition contested — 3+ researcher endorsement bar non-trivial (-2pp)
Polymarket OpenAI-AGI-by-2027 still at ~9% (-2pp)
key_uncertainties: Whether Anthropic's Project Glasswing-class models trigger AGI claims
How quickly OpenAI/DeepMind escalate post-Anthropic-momentum
What capability threshold satisfies the resolution criterion

update_triggers.up: A credible lab publicly declares AGI, or 3+ leading researchers endorse a specific milestone
update_triggers.down: Stall in frontier capability benchmarks; major labs walk back near-term timelines

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?
forecasts.key_change: McKinsey announced ~10% workforce cut (~200 internal tech/support roles automated by AI). Q1 2026 saw 80,000+ tech industry layoffs with ~50% AI-attributed; 61,000+ AI-driven layoffs across all sectors. Meta and Microsoft 20K+ cuts add to AI labor disruption narrative. Anthropic CEO Amodei reiterating 'unusually painful' job disruption warnings. But 33% sector-wide decline by Dec 2030 still requires a sustained downshift. Slight uptick from 18% to 19%.
forecasts.base_rate: ~15-20% — typical major industry sees 20-30% decline only under severe disruption (e.g., print media)
factors_up: McKinsey 10% layoffs tied explicitly to AI automation (+3pp)
61,000+ AI-driven layoffs in 2026 already, accelerating from 2025 (+2pp)
Junior consultants outputting mid-level work with AI tooling — compresses leverage model (+2pp)
Big-3 strategy firms publicly experimenting with AI-first delivery (+1pp)
factors_down: 'AI-washing' suggests some attribution is rhetorical, not structural (-3pp)
Demand for advisory work in AI transformation rising — partial offset (-2pp)
33% threshold is severe; even disrupted industries rarely lose that much in 4 years (-3pp)
Resolution requires 2+ credible analyses — could be contested (-2pp)
key_uncertainties: Whether AI disruption materially compresses billable hours by 2027-28
How much of current layoffs reflect cyclical vs. structural shift
Whether Big-4/MBB firms reposition into AI advisory or shrink

update_triggers.up: MBB/Big-4 announces ≥15% workforce cut citing AI; revenue declines materialise
update_triggers.down: Consultancy revenue continues growing through 2026-27; AI-augmentation thesis dominates

'Your Party' fragmenting the left further benefits Reform. Slight downtick from 4% to 3%.

Labour can change leader pre-election (+1pp)

forecasts.question: Will China initiate a military blockade or invasion of Taiwan before 1 January 2030?

Liaoning carrier transit on April 20 — first since December — and 159 aircraft + 199 vessel patrols are characterised as routine intimidation, not blockade preparation. Taiwan announced new drills to break a hypothetical energy blockade (April 12 Bloomberg). Polymarket 'blockade by June 30' market provides near-term pricing. AEI assesses PRC may be 'setting conditions' for blockade narrative but no operational mobilisation. Hold at 10%.

factors_up: PRC information operations 'setting conditions' for blockade narrative (+2pp)

forecasts.question: Will UK annual CPI inflation fall below 2.0% for at least one month before 1 January 2027?
forecasts.key_change: March 2026 CPI rose to 3.3% (from 3.0% Feb), with services inflation at 4.5% and core at 3.1%. BoE March 2026 minutes flag CPI expected at 3.0-3.5% over coming quarters due to Middle East energy shock. Bank Rate held at 3.75% with no cuts expected before Q3 2027 (Oxford Economics). With only May–Dec 2026 prints remaining and CPI running well above 3%, a sub-2.0% reading is essentially ruled out absent a severe demand shock. Hold at 1%.
forecasts.base_rate: Near-zero — sustained 3%+ inflation rarely falls >100bps in 6-7 months without major demand collapse
factors_up: Severe global recession could collapse energy/services prices (+1pp)
Statistical base effects in Q4 2026 marginally favourable (+1pp)
factors_down: March 2026 CPI 3.3% and rising trajectory (-3pp)
Services inflation 4.5% — sticky and structural (-3pp)
BoE expects 3.0-3.5% over the coming quarters (-2pp)
Middle East energy shock embedded in pipeline (-2pp)
Bank Rate held at 3.75%; no rapid easing expected (-1pp)
key_uncertainties: Whether Middle East energy shock unwinds rapidly
Whether services inflation cools faster than BoE projects
Whether a sharp sterling appreciation imports disinflation

update_triggers.up: Energy prices collapse 30%+; UK enters sharp recession with rapid disinflation
update_triggers.down: CPI rises further above 3.5%; services inflation re-accelerates

forecasts.question: Will Spider-Man: Brand New Day gross over $1.5B worldwide by 31 December 2026?
forecasts.key_change: Trailer crossed 1 billion views in 4 days (March 18 launch) — first movie trailer ever. 24-hour record of 718.6M views (vs. Deadpool & Wolverine's prior 365M). Logarithmic growth model implies $2.54B worldwide; conservative MCU-comparable model implies $2.31B. No Way Home grossed $1.9B with 355M-view trailer; Brand New Day's 1B trailer suggests materially higher ceiling. Release July 31 leaves 5 months of theatrical run before Dec 31. Slight uptick from 96% to 97%.

forecasts.question: Will UK average annual real GDP growth exceed 1.5% across the 2030s (2030-2039)?
forecasts.key_change: OBR March 2026 EFO: GDP growth averages 1.6% across 2027-2030; productivity growth path to 1.0% by end of forecast. November 2025 OBR revised medium-term productivity down by 0.3pp to 1.0% (from 1.3%). Labour supply growth expected ~0.5% as ageing population weighs on participation. With productivity ~1.0% + labour supply ~0.5% ≈ 1.5% trend GDP — right on threshold. Population ageing increases health/social care share, lowering aggregate productivity. Slight downtick from 44% to 43%.
forecasts.base_rate: ~40% — UK averaged ~1.4% real GDP growth in 2010s; trend has weakened, not strengthened
factors_up: OBR 2027-2030 average forecast 1.6% (slightly above threshold) (+3pp)
Potential AI/automation productivity tailwind in 2030s (+3pp)
Energy transition investment cycle could boost capex/output (+2pp)
factors_down: OBR cut medium-term productivity by 0.3pp to 1.0% (-3pp)
Labour supply growth ~0.5% — ageing structural drag (-3pp)
Health/social care share rising — lower productivity sectors (-2pp)
1.5% threshold above OBR central trend; little headroom (-2pp)
key_uncertainties: Whether AI delivers material productivity gains in 2030s
Whether net migration policy shifts increase labour supply
Whether public investment cycle sustains capital deepening

update_triggers.up: Productivity revisions upward; AI-attributed labour productivity acceleration
update_triggers.down: Recession 2027-29; further productivity downgrades; demographic shock
